_about: ElevenLabs casting for UNIT 4B. Fill each voice_id after creating the voice (Voice Design prompt below) or picking one from the Voice Library. Read by demo/elevenlabs_tts.py.
_stability_note: Eleven v3 stability works in three bands: 0.0 Creative (most expressive, follows audio tags hardest), 0.5 Natural, 1.0 Robust (steady, ignores many tags). Deadpan modes sit high, big emotions sit low.

steve.design_prompt: Comedic cartoon voice of a young American man in his late twenties. High-strung, panicky and slightly nasal, always on the verge of a meltdown. His voice cracks and squeaks when stressed, he rambles fast, laughs nervously and gasps a lot. Animated sitcom energy, wildly expressive and exaggerated, never formal.
steve.library_search: young american male, nervous, comedic, awkward

weak_sarcasm.use: trying to be sarcastic and failing

dad_joke_bomb.use: tells a pun, instantly regrets it

apology.use: apologizing to a ghost, a cat, a child

nana.design_prompt: Comedic cartoon voice of a tiny elderly British grandmother. Sweet, sing-song, wobbly old-lady voice that suddenly drops into a low, gravelly, menacing whisper, then bounces right back to sweet. Cheeky cackle, theatrical timing, wildly expressive, animated comedy style.
nana.library_search: old british woman, grandma, warm, sweet

deadpan_threat.use: the dark line, said like a recipe

cackle.use: laughing at her own dark joke

nostalgic.use: 'back in my day' stories that go very wrong

penny.design_prompt: Comedic cartoon voice performed by an adult woman for a bossy cartoon landlord: small, high-pitched, squeaky and nasal, extremely sassy, bored and condescending, snappy clipped delivery with dramatic eye-roll sighs. Animated sitcom style, wildly expressive, never formal.
penny._note: Child voices may be restricted in Voice Design and the Voice Library. If no child voice is available, design a small, high, youthful adult female voice and pitch it up +2 to +3 semitones in post with formants preserved.

ted.design_prompt: Comedic cartoon voice of a middle-aged British man playing a grumpy, whiny ghost. Theatrical sighs and overdramatic groans, passive-aggressive and mopey, giggles at his own terrible puns, with a wobbly spooky quality. Animated comedy style, wildly expressive, never formal.
ted.library_search: middle aged british man, dry, weary, sarcastic

passive_aggressive.use: default; dishes, thermostat, 'the walls are thin, Steve'

dad_joke.use: his specialty: delivers a pun, very pleased

melancholy.use: the cheese, the past, being dead

boo.use: a half-hearted spooky 'boo' out of obligation

ted.design_sample: Ohhh, not again. Someone touched my thermostat. I died in this apartment, Steve. I think I get to choose the temperature! Hey, why did the ghost go to the party? For the boos! Hehe. Boos!

snuggles.design_prompt: Comedic cartoon voice of a gruff, gravelly American tough-guy detective in a 1940s film noir parody. Overdramatic, deep and raspy narration with long tense pauses and sudden bursts of outrage, deadpan and self-important. Animated comedy style, wildly expressive.
snuggles.library_search: noir narrator, deep american male, gravelly, detective

cat_pun.use: the rare purr-fect pun, delivered like a confession

snuggles.design_sample: Apartment 4B. Three a.m. The city was asleep. Then I heard it. The can opener. Somebody was opening tuna, and it wasn't for me. They call me Snuggles. I let them. For now.

_expressions_note: A line with "expr" (one of the 26 face names in demo/cast.js) gets that expression's delivery and the character's base_speed. The character's flavor tag is added only to calm expressions marked "flavor": true, so it never fights a big emotion. A line with "mode" uses the named mode instead.
_sarcasm_note: The ten deliveries with a "face" key are voice-only sarcasm styles: use them as "expr" in a lines file, and draw the face named in "face" (one of the 26 in demo/cast.js) while the line plays.
